[[File:Tiger Slime Egg.png|24px|link=]] 8,000g }} '''Slime Eggs''' can be obtained as rare drops from [[slimes]] or by putting 100 [[slime]] into a [[Slime Egg-Press]]. Purple and red Slime Eggs can also be found in [[Skull Cavern#Treasure Rooms|treasure rooms]] in the Skull Cavern. One Green Slime Egg may be produced daily in a [[Slimejack]] [[Fish Pond]] when the population of the pond reaches 9. A Tiger Slime Egg might drop when a [[Slimes|Tiger Slime]] is killed in the [[Volcano Dungeon]] or West area of [[Ginger Island]]. One Tiger Slime Egg may be produced daily in a [[Lionfish]] [[Fish Pond]] when the population of the pond reaches 9. The color of egg produced from a Slime Egg-Press is random. There is a 5% chance the egg will be purple, 9.5% chance of red, 21.375% chance of blue, and 64.125% chance of green. Once a [[Slime Hutch]] is built on [[the Farm]], there is a 1% chance that a slime (encountered anywhere) will drop a Slime Egg when slain. Green slimes drop green eggs, blue slimes drop blue eggs, red slimes drop red eggs, purple slimes drop purple eggs, and tiger slimes drop tiger slime eggs. Slime Eggs can be sold at different prices depending on the color, or placed in a [[Slime Incubator]]. ==Incubation== The Slime egg can be hatched into a slime in a [[Slime Incubator]]. The incubation takes 4000 minutes in game time, which amounts to 3 entire days (6 am to 2 am) and 6 hours. The [[Farming#Farming Skill|Coopmaster Profession]] cuts this time in half. Green eggs will hatch green slimes, blue eggs hatch blue slimes, red eggs hatch red slimes, purple eggs hatch purple slimes, and tiger eggs hatch tiger slimes. The gender of the egg is completely random and can't be found out before hatching the egg. ==Gifting== {{GiftsByItem|hate=Robin,Demetrius,Linus,Leo,Pam,Jodi,Kent,Leah,Shane,Elliott,Harvey,Sandy, Maru,Sebastian,Pierre,Caroline,Alex,George,Evelyn,Lewis,Clint,Penny,Emily,Sam,Marnie,Gus,Dwarf,Wizard,Willy,Krobus,Abigail,Haley,Jas,Vincent}} ==Bundles== Slime Egg is not used in any [[bundles]]. ==Tailoring== Slime Egg is used in the spool of the [[2 Willow Lane#Sewing Machine|Sewing Machine]] to create the dyeable [[Tailoring#Pants|Baggy Pants]]. [[File:Baggy Pants.png|36px]] Slime Eggs can also be used as a [[Dyeing|dye]] in the dye pots located in [[Haley]]'s and [[Emily]]'s house, [[2 Willow Lane]]. The dye pots the eggs go into match their color, as follows: *Green Slime Eggs are a green dye *Blue Slime Eggs are a blue dye *Red Slime Eggs are a red dye *Purple Slime Eggs are a purple dye *Tiger Slime Eggs are an orange dye ==Quests== The Slime Egg is not used in any [[quests]]. ==References== See Object::performObjectDropInAction in the game code. ==History== {{History|1.0|Introduced.}} {{History|1.11|Increased sell price for all eggs.}} {{History|1.4|Can now be used in [[Tailoring]].
